<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Implement the `verify-cron-secret.ts` file in the specified path to handle cron job secret verification.

The code defines a function to normalize bearer tokens by removing the "Bearer " prefix and checking for valid token length. It also includes a timing-safe string comparison function that encodes strings to bytes and compares their lengths to prevent timing attacks.

The code implements a function to verify cron requests by checking the authorization header against the stored secret, returning appropriate responses for missing or invalid credentials. It uses timing-safe comparison to prevent timing attacks and handles cases where the secret is missing or the token is invalid.

The implementation uses `crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual` for secure string comparison, requiring `Uint8Array` input. While Node 18+ supports this API, Edge runtime compatibility is assumed. For length-based timing leaks, the code follows a common pattern of comparing lengths first and returning early if they differ, avoiding direct timing-safe comparison when lengths vary. This prevents leakage of secret length while maintaining security. A simpler approach avoids hashing or padding by checking lengths upfront before performing a timing-safe comparison.</details></think>
